khaneqah.definition: A Sufi lodge - a residence and gathering place for a teacher and the students, wanderers, and ordinary townsfolk who came to hear him, eat with him, and sometimes stay.

khudi.definition: Persian for "I-ness" or selfhood - in the vocabulary this teacher used, the one veil a man had to work hardest to see past, the self-assertion standing between him and everything beyond it.
